features.name: Strict JSON Schema Enforcement
features.summary: Guarantees 100% adherence to a provided JSON schema using grammar-constrained sampling, eliminating malformed outputs.
gotchas: OpenAI requires 'strict: true' inside response_format and all object fields must specify 'additionalProperties: false'.
Anthropic lacks a native top-level strict mode; developers must use a forced tool choice ('tool_choice: { type: "tool", name: "schema_name" }').
Gemini supports strict response_schema natively via 'response_mime_type: "application/json"' and 'response_schema'.

gpt-4o.label: Native Strict
gpt-4o.sdkParam: response_format: { type: 'json_schema', json_schema: { strict: true, schema: ... } }
gpt-4o.notes: 100% adherence. All object keys must be marked required.

gpt-4o-mini.label: Native Strict
gpt-4o-mini.sdkParam: response_format: { type: 'json_schema', json_schema: { strict: true, schema: ... } }
gpt-4o-mini.notes: Fastest and cheapest strict schema validation.

o3-mini.label: Native Strict
o3-mini.sdkParam: response_format: { type: 'json_schema', json_schema: { strict: true, schema: ... } }
o3-mini.notes: Generates internal reasoning first, then emits strictly validated JSON.

claude-3-5-sonnet.label: Tool Choice Hack
claude-3-5-sonnet.sdkParam: tool_choice: { type: 'tool', name: 'json_output' }, tools: [{ name: 'json_output', input_schema: ... }]
claude-3-5-sonnet.notes: No native response_format. Must define schema as a tool and force its invocation.

claude-3-5-haiku.label: Tool Choice Hack
claude-3-5-haiku.notes: High schema fidelity, but consumes tool token overhead.

gemini-2-0-flash.label: Native Schema
gemini-2-0-flash.notes: Native Pydantic or JSON schema validation at 120+ T/s.

gemini-1-5-pro.label: Native Schema
gemini-1-5-pro.notes: Works across massive context windows (up to 2M tokens).

deepseek-v3.label: Standard JSON
deepseek-v3.notes: Guarantees valid JSON syntax, but does not strictly validate keys against a schema.

deepseek-r1.label: Prompt Constrained
deepseek-r1.sdkParam: System prompt: 'Return ONLY JSON in ```json blocks'
deepseek-r1.notes: Thinking tokens precede the output; strict JSON mode is officially unsupported.

llama-3-3-70b.label: Native Strict (Groq)
llama-3-3-70b.notes: Groq supports CFG/grammar constrained decoding natively.

codeExamples.python:
# OpenAI Strict JSON Schema
from pydantic import BaseModel
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI()

class CalendarEvent(BaseModel):
    title: str
    date: str
    participants: list[str]

response = client.beta.chat.completions.parse(
    model="gpt-4o",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Dinner with Alice tomorrow at 7pm"}],
    response_format=CalendarEvent,
)
event = response.choices[0].message.parsed
codeExamples.php:
<?php
// OpenAI PHP Strict JSON Schema
require "vendor/autoload.php";

$client = OpenAI::client(getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"));

$response = $client->chat()->create([
    "model" => "gpt-4o",
    "messages" => [
        ["role" => "user", "content" => "Dinner with Alice tomorrow at 7pm"],
    ],
    "response_format" => [
        "type" => "json_schema",
        "json_schema" => [
            "name" => "calendar_event",
            "strict" => true,
            "schema" => [
                "type" => "object",
                "properties" => [
                    "title" => ["type" => "string"],
                    "date" => ["type" => "string"],
                    "participants" => ["type" => "array", "items" => ["type" => "string"]],
                ],
                "required" => ["title", "date", "participants"],
                "additionalProperties" => false,
            ],
        ],
    ],
]);

$event = json_decode($response->choices[0]->message->content, true);
print_r($event);

features.name: Prefix Prompt Caching
features.summary: Caches static tokens (system instructions, documents, tools) to reduce input cost by 50% to 90% and lower latency.
gotchas: Anthropic charges a 1.25x (+25%) write premium for a 5-minute TTL, but grants a 90% discount on reads (min 1,024 tokens).
OpenAI caches prefixes automatically above 1,024 tokens with 50% discount and zero write surcharge.
Gemini requires 32,768 minimum tokens for explicit caching and charges an hourly storage fee ($4.50/M/hr on Pro, $1.00 on Flash).
DeepSeek caches in 64-token chunks with a 90% read discount.

gpt-4o.label: Auto Prefix (50%)
gpt-4o.notes: No special headers required. 50% discount on cached reads.

o3-mini.label: Auto Prefix (50%)
o3-mini.notes: Caches system prompts and tool declarations across reasoning turns.

claude-3-5-sonnet.label: Explicit 90% Off
claude-3-5-sonnet.notes: 1.25x write cost; 90% discount on reads ($0.30/M). Min 1,024 tokens. 5m TTL.

claude-3-5-haiku.label: Explicit 90% Off
claude-3-5-haiku.notes: Drops input tokens to an astonishing $0.08/M on cached hits.

gemini-2-0-flash.label: Explicit (32k min)
gemini-2-0-flash.notes: 75% read discount ($0.025/M). Requires min 32,768 tokens. Hourly storage fee.

gemini-1-5-pro.label: 2M Cache King
gemini-1-5-pro.notes: Cache entire codebases or hours of video. $4.50/M tokens/hr storage fee.

deepseek-v3.label: 64-Tok Chunks (90%)
deepseek-v3.notes: Fine-grained 64-token chunking. $0.014/M cached read (cheapest on Earth).

llama-3-3-70b.label: Unsupported
llama-3-3-70b.notes: Groq LPUs re-compute KV caches at wire speed without stateful caching.

codeExamples.python:
# Anthropic Prompt Caching
import anthropic

client = anthropic.Anthropic()
response = client.messages.create(
    model="claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022",
    max_tokens=1024,
    system=[
        {
            "type": "text",
            "text": LARGE_10K_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
            "cache_control": {"type": "ephemeral"}  # Marks prefix for caching
        }
    ],
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Analyze this code."}]
)
print("Cached tokens read:", response.usage.cache_read_input_tokens)
codeExamples.php:
<?php
// Anthropic PHP Prompt Caching (90% Read Discount)
require "vendor/autoload.php";

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->post("https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages", [
    "headers" => [
        "x-api-key" => getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"),
        "anthropic-version" => "2023-06-01",
        "anthropic-beta" => "prompt-caching-2024-07-31",
        "content-type" => "application/json",
    ],
    "json" => [
        "model" => "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022",
        "max_tokens" => 1024,
        "system" => [
            [
                "type" => "text",
                "text" => file_get_contents("large_corporate_docs.txt"), // > 1,024 tokens
                "cache_control" => ["type" => "ephemeral"],
            ],
        ],
        "messages" => [
            ["role" => "user", "content" => "Summarize the compliance requirements."],
        ],
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody()->getContents(), true);

features.name: Configurable Thinking / Reasoning Budget
features.summary: Enables chain-of-thought tokens during inference with explicit budget caps or effort levels.
gotchas: OpenAI o-series uses 'reasoning_effort: "low" | "medium" | "high"' rather than an exact token integer.
Anthropic uses an exact token count ('thinking: { type: "enabled", budget_tokens: 2048 }') with a 1,024 token minimum.
DeepSeek-R1 always thinks natively and emits reasoning between <think> and </think> tags; cannot be disabled via API.

gpt-4o.label: No Thinking
gpt-4o.notes: Standard autoregressive model without internal CoT.

o3-mini.label: Reasoning Effort
o3-mini.notes: Selectable effort levels. Does not allow exact token counts.

claude-3-5-sonnet.label: Exact Token Budget
claude-3-5-sonnet.notes: Fine-grained control. Minimum 1,024 budget tokens required.

claude-3-5-haiku.label: No Thinking
claude-3-5-haiku.notes: Designed for pure speed without reasoning latency.

gemini-2-0-flash.label: Thinking Budget
gemini-2-0-flash.notes: Adjustable thinking budget or set to 0 to disable thinking entirely.

deepseek-r1.label: Always-On CoT
deepseek-r1.notes: Self-determines thinking length. Thinking tokens billed at output rate.

codeExamples.python:
# Anthropic Exact Token Thinking Budget
import anthropic

client = anthropic.Anthropic()
response = client.messages.create(
    model="claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219",
    max_tokens=4096,
    thinking={
        "type": "enabled",
        "budget_tokens": 2048
    },
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Solve this complex distributed systems consensus problem."}]
)

features.name: Native Audio Input & Speech Perception
features.summary: Ingests raw audio bytes directly into the transformer without an external Whisper transcription step.
gotchas: Gemini 2.0 Flash natively accepts raw audio, video, and text in the same prompt with millisecond timestamp markers.
OpenAI GPT-4o supports audio via the Chat Completions modal/audio API, billed per audio token.
Anthropic Claude does NOT support direct audio ingestion; developers must transcribe via Whisper or Deepgram first.

gpt-4o.label: Native Audio In
gpt-4o.notes: Requires audio input parameter. $100/1M audio tokens.

claude-3-5-sonnet.label: Requires Whisper
claude-3-5-sonnet.notes: No native audio input. Transcribe first.

gemini-2-0-flash.label: Native Audio/Live
gemini-2-0-flash.notes: Lowest latency audio understanding. Supports full hours of audio or live streams.

gemini-1-5-pro.label: Up to 9.5 Hours
gemini-1-5-pro.notes: Upload multi-hour podcast or meeting recordings directly.

codeExamples.python:
# Gemini 2.0 Flash Audio Perception
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()
with open("meeting.mp3", "rb") as f:
    audio_bytes = f.read()

response = client.models.generate_content(
    model="gemini-2.0-flash",
    contents=[
        genai.types.Part.from_bytes(data=audio_bytes, mime_type="audio/mp3"),
        "Provide a timestamped transcript and action items."
    ]
)
print(response.text)
codeExamples.php:
<?php
// Gemini 2.0 Flash Raw Audio Perception in PHP
require "vendor/autoload.php";

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$apiKey = getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY");
$audioBase64 = base64_encode(file_get_contents("voice_memo.mp3"));

$response = $client->post("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.0-flash:generateContent?key={$apiKey}", [
    "json" => [
        "contents" => [
            [
                "parts" => [
                    [
                        "inline_data" => [
                            "mime_type" => "audio/mp3",
                            "data" => $audioBase64,
                        ],
                    ],
                    ["text" => "Detect tone of voice, summarize key points, and list next actions."],
                ],
            ],
        ],
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
echo $data["candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"];

features.name: Native PDF Document & Layout Understanding
features.summary: Processes entire PDF documents including multi-column formatting, embedded charts, figures, and tables.
gotchas: Anthropic converts each PDF page to an image internally, preserving visual layout (billed per page image).
Gemini processes PDFs visually with native page-level indexing up to 1,000 pages.
DeepSeek and Groq do not accept PDFs via API; developers must extract raw text or OCR externally.

gpt-4o.label: Via Assistant API
gpt-4o.sdkParam: File Search tool or manual page rasterization
gpt-4o.notes: Chat completions API lacks direct PDF upload; requires rasterizing pages as images.

o3-mini.label: Text Only
o3-mini.notes: Does not accept PDF or image inputs.

claude-3-5-sonnet.label: Native Visual PDF
claude-3-5-sonnet.notes: Preserves tables, graphs, and formatting. Up to 32MB / 100 pages.

gemini-1-5-pro.label: 1,000+ Pages
gemini-1-5-pro.notes: Ingest entire textbooks, legal filings, or annual reports.

deepseek-v3.label: Text Only
deepseek-v3.notes: Must extract text using pdfplumber/tesseract first.

codeExamples.php:
<?php
// Anthropic Native PDF Layout Understanding in PHP
require "vendor/autoload.php";

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$pdfBase64 = base64_encode(file_get_contents("quarterly_earnings.pdf"));

$response = $client->post("https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages", [
    "headers" => [
        "x-api-key" => getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"),
        "anthropic-version" => "2023-06-01",
        "content-type" => "application/json",
    ],
    "json" => [
        "model" => "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022",
        "max_tokens" => 2048,
        "messages" => [
            [
                "role" => "user",
                "content" => [
                    [
                        "type" => "document",
                        "source" => [
                            "type" => "base64",
                            "media_type" => "application/pdf",
                            "data" => $pdfBase64,
                        ],
                    ],
                    ["type" => "text", "text" => "Extract chart trends and quarterly EBITDA margin figures."],
                ],
            ],
        ],
    ],
]);

$result = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
echo $result["content"][0]["text"];

features.name: Native Sandboxed Code Execution
features.summary: Model can write and execute Python code in an ephemeral secure sandbox during inference to calculate exact answers or generate files.
gotchas: Gemini provides native Python code execution at zero extra charge with the 'code_execution: {}' tool.
OpenAI requires the Code Interpreter tool via the Assistants/Threads API, which incurs extra active session pricing ($0.03/session).
Anthropic models do not have a built-in serverless sandbox; the client must execute bash/python code locally or via E2B.

gpt-4o.label: Via Assistant API
gpt-4o.notes: Not supported in raw Chat Completions endpoint. $0.03/session fee.

o3-mini.label: No Sandbox
o3-mini.notes: Generates code text but cannot execute it in-turn.

claude-3-5-sonnet.label: External Runner
claude-3-5-sonnet.notes: API emits tool call; developer must host the execution environment.

gemini-2-0-flash.label: Free Native Sandbox
gemini-2-0-flash.notes: Iteratively writes, runs, and inspects Python output inside the call at $0 extra.

gemini-1-5-pro.label: Free Native Sandbox
gemini-1-5-pro.notes: Solves math, complex statistical analysis, and data cleaning in-flight.

deepseek-r1.label: No Sandbox
deepseek-r1.notes: Reasons about code, but cannot execute.

codeExamples.php:
<?php
// Gemini Sandboxed Code Execution Tool in PHP
require "vendor/autoload.php";

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$apiKey = getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY");

$response = $client->post("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.0-flash:generateContent?key={$apiKey}", [
    "json" => [
        "tools" => [
            ["code_execution" => new stdClass()],
        ],
        "contents" => [
            [
                "parts" => [
                    ["text" => "Compute the standard deviation of this array [42, 19, 73, 88, 12, 65] using Python."],
                ],
            ],
        ],
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
print_r($data["candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"]);

features.name: Live Search Grounding & Web Retrieval
features.summary: Grounds answers with real-time web search results and verified citation links directly from the model provider.
gotchas: Gemini connects directly to Google Search with rich citation chips and query metadata ($35/1k search queries or free tier).
OpenAI connects to web search via the 'responses' API or Assistants search tool.
Anthropic has no native web search grounding; developers must integrate Tavily, Exa, or Google Serper via tools.

gpt-4o.label: Responses API
gpt-4o.notes: Available in beta on select endpoints.

claude-3-5-sonnet.label: Requires Tavily/Exa
claude-3-5-sonnet.notes: No native search. Must integrate external search API via tools.

gemini-2-0-flash.label: Native Google Search
gemini-2-0-flash.notes: Instant Google Search results with citation URLs and searchEntryPoint html.

gemini-1-5-pro.label: Native Google Search
gemini-1-5-pro.notes: Google Search grounding across complex research queries.

deepseek-r1.label: No Search
deepseek-r1.notes: Pure latent CoT; no live web browsing.

codeExamples.python:
# Gemini Google Search Grounding
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()
response = client.models.generate_content(
    model="gemini-2.0-flash",
    contents="What were the major announcements at today's tech conferences?",
    config={"tools": [{"google_search": {}}]}
)
print(response.text)
# Access citations and grounding sources
grounding = response.candidates[0].grounding_metadata
for chunk in grounding.grounding_chunks or []:
    print(f"Source: {chunk.web.title} -> {chunk.web.uri}")

            ["google_search" => new stdClass()],

features.name: 1M+ Massive Context Window
features.summary: Allows processing over 1,000,000 tokens of input (equivalent to hundreds of thousands of lines of code or multi-hour video) in a single request.
gotchas: Gemini 1.5 Pro and 2.0 Flash are the only commercial frontier models supporting 1M to 2M tokens in production.
Anthropic Claude 3.5 models are capped at 200,000 tokens.
OpenAI models are capped at 128,000 tokens (o3-mini is 200,000).

gemini-1-5-pro.label: 2,097,152 Tokens
gemini-1-5-pro.notes: Industry record 2 Million tokens context window.

codeExamples.python:
# Gemini 2M Context Window Call
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()
# Ingest millions of tokens (entire codebase or repositories)
response = client.models.generate_content(
    model="gemini-1.5-pro",
    contents=[HUGE_DATASET_OVER_1M_TOKENS, "Find the subtle security vulnerability."]
)
